company context layer

Reliable context, for every agent.

Structure what your company knows. Maintain it with people in the loop. Retrieve it from Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, your coding agent, Slack and any agent that speaks MCP, all reading the same copy.

Book a demoHow it works

01Structure · one copy per thing

02Maintain · every save is a version

03Retrieve · any agent, the same copy

04Search · only what you may open

Three layers. Each one on point.

A context layer is only as reliable as its weakest layer, so Atlas is built as three, and each one does a single job well.

  1. 01Structure

    Structure what your company knows.

    Guidance, skills, knowledge, tables and metrics, each a typed object with an owner and a scope. Not a pile of documents: a procedure is a skill, a fact is a page, a number is a metric.

    • Guidance
    • Skills
    • Knowledge
    • Tables
    • Metrics
  2. 02Maintain

    Maintain it with people in the loop.

    Every save is a version. Agents propose changes as diffs a person approves. Automations keep pages current, insights show the gaps, and every change lands in the audit log.

    • Change requests
    • Audit
    • Automations
    • Insights
  3. 03Retrieve

    Retrieve it from any agent.

    Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, your coding agent, a Slack agent, a script on a schedule: any agent that speaks MCP signs in as a person, finds what that person may open, and reads the same copy as everyone else.

    • MCP
    • Search
    • Playground
    • Evaluations

One copy. Any number of readers.

Skills are how work gets done. Knowledge is what is true. Metrics are what words mean. Each is kept once, in Atlas, and every agent retrieves the same copy.

Everything in each layer, and how it stays honest.

Pick a layer, then an object, to see what it looks like inside Atlas.

01

Guidance

How agents should behave here. A few short guides an agent reads before it starts: tone, house rules, what to check first, what never to do.

guide · before you start · read by every agent

02

Skills

How a job is done here. A skill is a written procedure that agents follow. Each save is a new version with a note on what changed, and an owner can restore any older one.

skill · month-end-close · v0.1.4 · published

03

Knowledge

What is true here. Pages your team writes together in a live editor, with comments, tasks and links between pages. Agents read the same pages people do.

page · finance / payout schedule · live

04

Tables

Your warehouse, described. Each BigQuery or Snowflake table carries notes on what it holds and how to use it, so every agent queries it the same way.

table · analytics.orders · 14 columns · read-only

05

Metrics

What a number means here. A metric is SQL over your warehouse, agreed once, so every agent gives the same answer for churn.

metric · active customers · bigquery · run preview

06

Scopes

Who may see it. Pages and skills sit in a teamspace or in someone's private space, with view, comment, edit or full access. An agent never sees more than the person it works for.

scope · finance › payout schedule › maya chen (edit)

07

Change requests

An agent's edit arrives as a change request. A person reads the diff and approves or rejects it, block by block, like a pull request.

change request · payout schedule · from slack agent · pending review

08

Audit

See who and which agents read or changed your context. A workspace-wide trail of reads, edits and approvals across every surface.

audit · payout schedule · who, what, when

09

Automations

Keep context fresh with scheduled and triggered work. Run a model you connect, on your key, to review, sync and propose updates for a person to approve.

automation · weekly churn notes · mondays 9:00

10

Insights

Understand how your context is used and where it has gaps. Usage, stale pages, unanswered questions and coverage in one place.

insights · 12 stale pages · 6 unanswered questions

11

MCP

Claude Desktop, ChatGPT, your coding agent, a Slack agent or the command line connects over MCP and signs in as a person. One endpoint, the same tools for every client.

app.atlascontext.ai/mcp · sign in as yourself

12

Search

Search checks access before it ranks. People and agents only find what they may open, in the browser and over MCP.

search · "refund policy" · only what you can open

13

Playground

Ask a question the way an agent would. See what it finds, what it reads and what it answers, before any agent does it for real.

playground · "when do payouts settle?" · 3 sources

14

Evaluations

Measure how well agents find and use your context. Score retrieval against reference questions and track answer quality over time.

evaluation · finance questions · 48 / 52 passing
